versions.changelog:
Initial release of the modao-hot-trend skill.

- Enables extraction and summarization of public Modao (墨刀) project and share pages.
- Supports organizing page structures, interaction flows, elements, and annotation details.
- Only processes publicly accessible information; no project modification or login operations.
- Includes resource link aggregation (e.g., design specs, exports).
- Follows platform compliance and information security guidelines.
